title: Would you play my game? IRONWAKE - demo
author: j3y3m3
selftext:
Hi,  
  
I have been working on a game called IRONWAKE. It is pretty much Vampire Survivor or Wanderburg but on a ship against the naval enemies and sea monsters.   
  
It started because I just wanted to see some powerful looking guns on a battleship, fighting against bunch of warships and monsters. 

It is nothing realistic like World of Warships, nor it has crazy graphics. I don't have enough knowledge to make it like that nor resources and experience. But I just wanted to make a fun game to play time to time, like one or two stages a day.  
  
It is running closed demo now, but if 10 people want to play it, I will make it public.   
Thank you for reading (and for watching the trailer).

comments.author: speaks-with-stone
comments.body: Looks neat! Is it is in the browser?

replies.author: j3y3m3
replies.body: Unfortunately no, not in browser but available in Windows and android
